subject: File control entry
notes: kb/Work PB702 (claimable since kb/Work PB324 landed; the row stayed GAP with an empty verdict while GR-12.4.5.3-3 already named the same goldens). RULE: 'Data-name-1 shall reference an alphanumeric data item and shall not be subordinate to the file description entry for file-name-1.' (cite.py --check 12.4.5.2 'Data-name-1 shall reference an alphanumeric data item and shall not be subordinate to the file description entry for file-name-1' -> OK, §12.4.5.2 7)). TWO HALVES, AND BOTH ARMS OF EACH ARE MEASURED. CODE: DataBinder.ResolveAssignUsing is the single site. Half 1 (category) is IsAlphanumericDataItem — an elementary PIC X item, or a group with no GROUP-USAGE clause, which 13.18.29.4 GR3 makes 'an alphanumeric group item'; category-ALPHABETIC (PIC A) is excluded because 8.8.4.2.4's 'A class alphabetic operand shall be treated as though it were an operand of class alphanumeric' is a COMPARISON rule and not a category identity, and bit/national groups are excluded by GroupUsage. An unresolvable name takes the same arm (there is no alphanumeric data item to reference), COBOL1810. Half 2 (subordination) walks item.Parent up to the root and fires COBOL1811 if any ancestor is one of THIS file's record descriptions — 'subordinate to the file description entry' means anywhere under a record description of that FD, which is the reading 9.1.21 corroborates ('The USING phrase references an alphanumeric data item whose content at the time an OPEN, SORT, or MERGE statement for that file is executed uniquely identifies the specific physical file to be accessed'), because an operand inside the file's own record area is overwritten by every READ of that file. MEASURED on this worktree's build (c34f01ad): `cobol pb324-assign-using-not-alphanumeric.cob --std 85` -> 'error COBOL1810: file ''NF1'': ASSIGN … USING ''WS-NUM'' shall reference an alphanumeric data item - ''WS-NUM'' is a category-numeric item (ISO 12.4.5.2 SR7)'; `cobol pb324-assign-using-in-own-record.cob --std 2023` -> 'error COBOL1811: file ''NF2'': ASSIGN … USING ''N2-NAME'' shall not be subordinate to the file description entry for ''NF2'' (ISO 12.4.5.2 SR7)'. Both negative goldens carry `*> reject-at: 85 2002 2014 2023`, so the REJECTING arm is asserted at every edition. The ACCEPTING arm — the complement, which a rejection test can never measure — is conformance:cases/9.1.13.6-Permanent-error-condition-with-unsuccessful-completion/pb324_assign_using_dynamic and conformance:85/pb324_assign_using_85, both of which name a WORKING-STORAGE `PIC X(20)` item outside the FD and run to a spec-derived expected output. || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: 85 / 2002 / 2014 / 2023. §12.4.5.2 carries no edition marker on SR7 and Annex E records no change to the ASSIGN clause; the compiler enforces the rule through one ungated site and both negatives are pinned as rejecting at all four editions. This is the band GR-12.4.5.3-3 was landed at for the same clause and the same goldens. NOT CLAIMED HERE, and separately observed: this compiler does not gate the ASSIGN … USING SPELLING itself at 1985 (probed: `cobol tests/conformance/85/pb324_assign_using_85.cob --std 85` compiles silently). Whether the USING spelling is writable at 1985 is GR-12.4.5.3-3's landed adjudication and a question about the ASSIGN clause's introduction, not about SR7 — SR7 is either enforced or vacuous at that edition, never violated. || 2026-09-06 (landing train 19, kb/Work PB742+PB743): the code-location's second half moved. DataBinder.IsAlphanumericDataItem was DELETED and its predicate extracted verbatim into ItemCategory.IsAlphanumeric - the ONE 8.5.2 category reader - which 12.4.5.12.3 SR2 and 12.4.5.6.3 SR2 now share through FileControlKeyRules. Behaviour-preserving, checked case by case in PB742's report (PIC X true/true, PIC A false/false, plain group true/true, GROUP-USAGE NATIONAL false/false, GROUP-USAGE BIT false/false, PICTURE-less non-group false/false); ResolveAssignUsing is still the single site and calls it at DataBinder.cs:1491. Verdict, editions and goldens unchanged. retired-witness: conformance:85/pb324_assign_using_85 (moved to conformance:cases/12.4.5-File-control/pb746_assign_using_2002: the USING phrase is a 2002 introduction (kb/Work PB746), so the golden runs at its introducing edition)
